page.overview:
Who is Albea?

Albea was a Human female scientist who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

During the Cold War, Albea was imprisoned for unknown reasons by Voontara Fa'athra in his palace on Nal Hutta. At the same time, the resurgent Sith Empire placed a bounty on Albea, who hired Trandoshan bounty hunter named Rarsk to hunt her.

The prospective Grand Champion of the Great Hunt was on quest to retrieve the Great Hunt sponsorship token from Rarsk and saved her from the Trandoshan, only to later kill and claim her bounty.

The player has the option to spare Albea instead of claiming the bounty on her, as she is not a required target of the Great Hunt.
